Priority 1: claim control (OPP-01, OPP-03) and scheme-pushed returns (OPP-05). Priority 2: potentially recoverable, free goods cap, reallocation. Priority 3: FEFO, dispatch, review and data requests.
Controller: raise set-off on T1, confirm T2, hold pending. CFO and NSM: scheme circular within the 3% cap. Supply Chain: reallocate
spare stock, raise Kolkata FEFO. The model explains; a person decides.
